_doc: Seed lumber spots for the self-optimizing lumber job (harness/lumber_opt.py, docs/LUMBER_LOOP.md §6). A spot = a tree area plus the bank its trips end at. The runner takes one with --spot ID (loop_lumber.py merges it over the common knowledge in loops/lumber.json). Statistics never live here: they come from the memory store (episodes, job_events, events). The overseer adds spots and `ctl lumber discover` proposes candidates in the store's lumber_spots table, which also overrides a seed's status. Ids equal the `venue` of the trip rows written before spots existed, so those rows count for their spot. hazard_prior = prior mean of hostile-player sightings per field hour [INFERENCE: a judgement per area type, replaced by data as trips accumulate]. travel_min = rough minutes to get there from another town (moongate + walk) [INFERENCE].

spots.name: Shelter Island (Young only)

area.note: Young may harvest in town on Shelter; harvest chance there is 50 % of normal and skills cap at 80 (wiki Shelter Island).

spots.travel: Shelter Island moongate; the bank and its banker serve Young characters only

area.note: Outside the south-east guard edge (harvesting is blocked in town). A skeleton roams around (2109,2209).

spots.name: Corpse Creek, between town and moongate (lawless)

area.note: Lawless: everyone reads grey, so a red can't be told by notoriety and any grey player within 18 tiles stops the runner (docs/NOTES.md 'PK death in the Terran wilds'). The first area (960,822 r25) ran dry after ~240 logs.

area.note: 115 tree statics x850-910 y1450-1510. A 12-radius area here ran dry in 11 min. Hackworth was killed here by a mounted red (2026-10-02 19:43, docs/NOTES.md).
